title: Pie Config
description: Defines all Layers and their Pie Items. Structural rules live here; semantic rules (listed in $comment) are enforced by the launcher on import.
$comment: Semantic import ERRORS (import rejected, nothing changes): baseLayer names no existing Layer; duplicate Layer ids; a Layer Switch targets an unknown Layer or its own Layer; an icon is not a Material Symbols Rounded name; version is higher than supported. Semantic import WARNINGS (import proceeds, list shown): an app/activity/shortcut reference does not resolve on this device; a Layer is unreachable from the Base Layer; the same target appears twice in one Layer; an app item without activity names a package with several launcher activities (the warning names the one launched and the alternatives). All errors are reported at once with their JSON path.

version.description: Schema version of this file. The launcher rejects versions higher than it supports.

baseLayer.description: Id of the Layer the Pie shows when it opens.

color.description: Fixed hex colour, or a Monet role that follows the wallpaper.

name.description: Human name; shown in import messages and exports, not in the Pie.

color.description: Layer colour, used e.g. for the Progress Disc and for Layer Switches pointing here.

icon.description: Material Symbols Rounded name shown on Layer Switches that target this Layer.

items.description: Pie Items, placed clockwise starting at 12 o'clock.

activity.description: Fully qualified launcher activity class. Omitted: launch what getLaunchIntentForPackage returns.

shortcutId.description: Opaque id from the Inventory (Vanadium: random UUID per add; Firefox: manifest start_url).
